scope: Canonical EVM/Tempo transaction and fee-token names, reviewed React callers, and removal of deprecated ordinary aliases.
composition: One internal factory privately shares the existing execution lifecycle across chain-specific public capabilities. Wire messages and execution implementation remain unchanged.
bootstrap: Host calls use advanced bootstrap with the existing chain-specific builders. EVM advanced bootstrap no longer inherits the Tempo builder. Further bootstrap internalization remains open.

productionLines.exclusions: Type fixtures, tests, docs, generated artifacts, lockfiles

cases: [wallet-intended] 1/3 e2e/intended-behaviours/email-otp.unlock.contract.test.ts:9 Email OTP registration and unlock lifecycle
[wallet-intended] 2/3 e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.registration.contract.test.ts:176 custom review requires wallet approval before a live Arc signature
[wallet-intended] 3/3 e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.registration.contract.test.ts:459 passkey registration establishes an immediately usable owner session without waiting for presignatures
verification.productionCommand: SEAMS_INTENDED_PRODUCTION=1 SEAMS_INTENDED_SKIP_BUILD=1 node tests/scripts/run-wallet-intended-isolated.mjs --require-google-token -- e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.registration.contract.test.ts e2e/intended-behaviours/email-otp.unlock.contract.test.ts --grep 'custom review requires wallet approval|Email OTP registration and unlock lifecycle|passkey registration establishes an immediately usable owner session'
verification.browserCommand: SEAMS_TEST_FRONTEND_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4289 pnpm -C tests exec playwright test -c playwright.wallet-browser.config.ts wallet-ui/transaction-review.browser.test.ts --project=chromium --output=../.artifacts/r170-transaction-names

limitations: Browser send-method coverage uses stub-host rejection and review behavior, not real-chain submission.
Production cases exercise real signatures, approval, and lifecycle restoration, not live-chain send/finalization or fee-token submission.
NEAR transaction consolidation, internal bootstrap ownership, full worker matrix, returning-user performance, and consumer-release acceptance remain open.
